title: Muthoot Finance, Manappuram Finance shares decline up to 3.5% as gold prices hit multi-month lows
summary: Gold loan NBFCs, including Muthoot and Manappuram, have seen significant stock declines related to falling gold prices and heightened US Federal Reserve rate hike expectations.
